verdicts.reason: Both are broken the same way at the top. A is the less bad one because it places BEDDING mid-canvas between the dot patterns, so it reads as a centred headline, even though it's cut off from 'Baby & Toddler'. B pushes BEDDING to the bottom edge, which separates the phrase even more and leaves the dot patterns floating in empty space.
